status_legend.used: Collected by a script in this repository and part of the published results
status_legend.planned: Documented candidate source; nothing in the repository reads it yet
status_legend.evaluated: Inspected for this project and documented; not read by any script because it adds nothing the used sources lack
status_legend.not_accessible: Referenced by the author but not readable from the development environment; nothing could be verified

sources.name: FastF1
sources.role: Primary tier: every race 2018-2026, laps, sectors, tyres, track status, weather (scripts/fetch_fastf1_seasons.py)
sources.coverage_note: Detailed timing/telemetry is strongest from 2018 onward
sources.local_policy: Cache locally/Google Drive; do not commit raw data

sources.name: Jolpica / Ergast
sources.role: Legacy tier: every race 2000-2017, lap times, positions, pit stops from 2011 (scripts/fetch_jolpica_seasons.py)
sources.coverage_note: No sectors, tyres, track status or weather; lap validity is a documented heuristic
sources.local_policy: Stay under the public rate limit; do not commit raw data

sources.name: OpenF1
sources.role: Second timing provider 2023-2026: every race and sprint with laps, sectors, stints, pit stops, positions, weather and race control (scripts/fetch_openf1.py, src/raceshift/data/openf1_loader.py). Used for the cross-provider check against FastF1, for sprint sessions (the FastF1 tables hold races only) and for the OpenF1-sourced fine-tuning experiments
sources.coverage_note: Historical data from 2023 onward without authentication; rows are tagged data_tier = openf1_timing and carry the same columns as the FastF1 tier. Lap times agree with FastF1 to the millisecond from lap 2 on; the opening lap is timed differently by the two providers
sources.local_policy: Polite client (spaced requests, back-off on 429); every response cached as JSON under data/cache/openf1; per-session parquet under data/raw/openf1; do not commit raw data

sources.name: Ergast database dump on Kaggle (jtrotman/formula-1-race-data)
sources.role: Offline mirror of the legacy tier: lap_times.csv (1996-2026), pit_stops.csv, races, drivers, results, constructors and circuits, converted by scripts/build_ergast_kaggle.py with the same rules as the Jolpica API loader (src/raceshift/data/ergast_csv_loader.py). Adds 1996-1999 and the current season without API calls; used for the lap-for-lap integrity checks in reports/data_sources
sources.coverage_note: Same data as Jolpica/Ergast: no sectors, tyres, track status or weather. Matches the API rows for 2000-2017 and FastF1 lap times for 2018-2026 on 99.4% of shared laps; the remainder are known Ergast lap-alignment errors in a few races
sources.local_policy: Download with kagglehub or from the dataset page into data/raw/ergast_kaggle; do not commit the CSVs

sources.name: formula1-datasets (toUpperCase78)
sources.role: Season CSVs 2019-2026 of race results, qualifying results, sprint results, calendars, drivers and teams
sources.coverage_note: Race-level results only (finishing position, grid, points, fastest lap): no per-lap timing, so nothing RaceShift's next-lap model can train on; every field it holds is already implied by the lap tables' last-lap positions

sources.name: Kaggle notebook: feature-engineering-lgbm-regressor-f1-hackathon (jamesd2525)
sources.role: Suggested as a reference for feature engineering
sources.coverage_note: The Kaggle API token available to the development environment is not permitted to read notebooks (kernels.get denied), so its features and data could not be inspected or compared

sources.name: TracingInsights 2026
sources.role: Public telemetry archive; the 2026 domain-shift test currently uses FastF1 instead
sources.coverage_note: Telemetry, lap timing, weather, race control, corners
sources.local_policy: Prefer sparse/targeted download; verify license/terms before redistribution

sources.name: F1 Corner Telemetry 2024-2025
sources.role: Candidate for a corner encoder and self-supervised pretraining
sources.local_policy: Large data; stream/sample first, full download only in large research mode

sources.name: F1 StratLab Strategy Dataset
sources.local_policy: Optional benchmark data, not required for MVP
